title: One Open Program per Customer — Insulin Pump Program Eligibility Bulletin
content:
A customer holds at most 1 Insulin Pump Program at a time across every tier, because a person uses one insulin pump and a payer covers one pump and one set of pump supplies.

A new pump program is opened only when the customer has no pump program in referral received, pending authorization, active or on hold. A new pump, a new model or a new insurance for a customer with such a program is written as a program change on that program, and a closed program does not count.

| Customer's existing pump program status | New pump program may be opened |
|---|---|
| None | Yes |
| Closed | Yes — a closed program does not count |
| Referral received, pending authorization, active or on hold | No — the change is written on that program |
